ad_creative_bodies:
Former world rowing champion Erin Winslow stepped away from competition after being injured while saving Albert Harrington. She married his son, Victor, without revealing her wealth or family background. Victor now dismisses her as a useless wife living off his family.
At a charity rowing team tryout on the Charles River, Victor lets his ambitious trainee, Chloe Blake, humiliate Erin. A 2,000-meter challenge soon puts Bitcoin, valuable commercial property, and the future of Erin’s marriage at stake.
What they do not know is that Erin is the world champion invited to select the team—and the sister of a powerful business leader. As her signature launch and one-oar finish expose her true ability, contempt turns into desperate flattery. Erin wins by twenty-nine seconds, directs the Bitcoin winnings to a youth rowing fund, and claims the right to decide her future. Victor begs for another chance. Erin chooses divorce.
